high_level_description: The image is an invitation card for a festive Dealer Meet organized by Duroflex. The background features a vibrant red pattern with floral motifs, giving it a celebratory and traditional feel. At the top of the card, there is a yellow decorative banner with the text "duroflex THALAMAI THODAKKAM" written in bold, red and black fonts. The word "THALAMAI" is larger and more prominent, suggesting it might be the main theme or event name. Below the banner, there is a photograph of a man wearing a cream-colored traditional Indian outfit, with his hands joined in a Namaste
